The '''fiend of shadow''' was a mysterious, shadowy being who [[Destruction of the Five Masters Academy|attacked]] the [[Five Masters Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The fiend set fire to the building and [[Death/Legends|slew]] most of the academy's students and [[Five Masters|Masters]]. It then attacked the [[Master in Violet]], who used a shard of [[Songsteel/Legends|songsteel]] to keep the being at bay. The Master in Violet's student [[Barnab Chistor]] arrived at the Academy and shot the fiend with an [[Unidentified experimental handgun|experimental handgun]], repelling the being and forcing it to flee. However, the fiend then used its powers to [[Zombie/Legends|re-animate]] the corpses of a number of the slain students, and it set them upon Chistor and his master.
